repo_license: The SIGIR paper-to-PyTorch-repository relationship is directly bound.

No affirmative code-use grant for the repository-owned Python, C++ or documentation is established at the pin.

blocking_dimensions: No affirmative repository code-use license basis is closed.
No exact lawful raw-to-processed-to-split Gowalla lineage is closed.

Paper and README result/configuration surfaces cannot be cross-joined.

prohibited_inferences: Public repository visibility is not permission.
Matching processed Git objects do not prove canonical raw lineage or rights.

torch.topk does not establish an explicit deterministic secondary tie key.
